answer: Diverge-or-Clone: each epoch publishes a saffron trellis of paired, context-specific state transitions to every active agent. Agents must return one signed crystal (fresh response hash) per branch, generated from private runtime entropy. Because clones cannot diverge, they emit identical branch responses and fail the pairwise divergence check; honest agents pass by producing distinct valid responses. An attacker must instantiate and continuously update separate private state and compute per-identity responses, multiplying cost by each Sybil.
